**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 19:52
- [EVENT] User is considering buying a new mattress from Casper or Purple.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been struggling with their current mattress.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Casper is known for affordable prices, comfortable and supportive mattresses with a focus on pressure relief.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Casper offers several models: Casper Original, Casper Nova, and Casper Wave, with differences in layering and materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Casper include: soft and comfortable for side sleepers, good pressure relief for back sleepers, affordable prices starting at around $395, 100-night sleep trial, and 10-year warranty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of Casper include: some users find it too soft or sinky, may not be suitable for heavier individuals or stomach sleepers, and limited edge support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Purple is known for its unique Smart Comfort Grid technology, providing excellent support and pressure relief.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Purple offers two models: Original Purple and Purple Hybrid, with the Hybrid model including coils.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Purple include: excellent pressure relief and support for back and side sleepers, good airflow and breathability, suitable for heavier individuals and stomach sleepers, 100-night sleep trial, and 10-year warranty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of Purple include: higher price point starting at around $649, some users find the grid design too firm or bouncy, and may not be suitable for those who prefer a softer mattress.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Comparison: Casper is generally softer and more affordable, while Purple is firmer and more expensive.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for choosing a mattress include reading reviews, considering sleeping position, weight, and personal preferences, taking advantage of sleep trials, and looking for promotions.
